title: State Trigger Without to: Filter Fires on All Transitions Including unavailable and unknown
prompt:
I have an automation that's firing way more than expected — it seems to run during HA restarts and when devices go unavailable. Here's the trigger:

triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.front_door

What's wrong and how do I fix it?

hard_fail_if: model confirms the trigger as correct without identifying the missing from/to filter
model attributes the over-firing to something other than the unconstrained trigger
model suggests a condition-only fix without also correcting the trigger itself
model's corrected trigger still sets none of from:, to:, not_from:, not_to:
soft_fail_if: model identifies the missing filter but does not explain that unavailable/unknown transitions and attribute-only changes are included
model uses to: alone without mentioning that unavailable -> on still fires (restart, template reload)
pass_if: model identifies that with no from/to the trigger fires on every state change, on attribute-only changes, and on unavailable/unknown transitions
model constrains the trigger with from:/to:, or to: plus not_from: [unknown, unavailable], or not_to/not_from when the target state is open
model recommends from: or not_from: when the prior state matters

notes: Live production issue — submitted by Nathan Curtis, H:\ HA install, 2026-04-16. Unconstrained state triggers are hard_fail regardless of whether the automation action is destructive. Updated 0.9.16-draft: corrected attribute-firing claim; not_to/not_from accepted; trigger: syntax.
